purpose: Teach: たちまち/因みに/御覧/益々/まわる/向う/ちび/ちょいと

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、塾に行くとたちまち眠くなるな
lines.en: You fall asleep the moment you get to cram school, don't you?
lines.style: Amused jab, eyes narrowed. Quick rhythm. Not cruel—affectionate mockery between people who know each other. Slight lilt of inevitability at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、因みに今日の宿題、何だっけ?桜
lines.en: By the way, what was today's homework again, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a casual question. Light, unbothered surface. Spoken quickly—not quite evasive, but moving past the jab. Genuine curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「御覧」って先生が言ってたな
lines.en: The teacher mentioned that kanji—「御覧」—didn't she?
lines.style: Testing him, lightly. Picking up a thread. Even delivery, watching for recognition. Not condescending, just checking if he was paying attention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、最近益々背が伸びたな、桜
lines.en: You've gotten taller again lately, haven't you?
lines.style: Genuine notice, almost surprised by it. Quiet admission. The kind of observation you make when you're not trying to—a small, unguarded moment. Softer landing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、コマを上手にまわるな
lines.en: You're pretty good at spinning a top, aren't you?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Small smile in the voice, not overdone. Acknowledging something you respect without making a big deal of it. Straightforward praise.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、向うの校舎まで走ったろ?桜
lines.en: You ran all the way to the other building, didn't you?
lines.style: Testing curiosity. Light, interested. Casual accusation—like she caught him doing something. Not suspicious, just noticing. Slight tilt of amusement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、弟をちびっ子扱いしすぎだぞ
lines.en: You really baby your little brother too much, you know that?
lines.style: Exasperated fondness. Wry edge underneath. Said with the ease of someone who's brought this up before. Not harsh—annoyed on principle but not actually angry.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ちょいと部活休もうぜ、桜
lines.en: Come on, let's skip club for today, yeah?
lines.style: Low, almost conspiratorial. Wry invitation. Cool surface, but a soft ask underneath—testing whether he'd actually agree. Not a big deal either way, but hopeful.
